Card Q&A.a: No. This card's effect only applies if a card with the exact name [Agumon] is one of its digivolution cards. Despite [Agumon Expert], [ToyAgumon], and other Digimon cards having [Agumon] in their names, the effect doesn't apply if it isn't an exact match.
Card Q&A.q: Does this card's effect apply if it has [Agumon Expert] or [ToyAgumon] as a digivolution card?

Effect: [Your Turn] While this Digimon has an [Agumon] digivolution card， it gains ＜Security Attack +1＞. (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
